prompts.name: lotus-in-the-tribulation-refined
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / high-definition refinement.
Edit the attached cover image. This is a careful professional clean-up and refinement of the SAME artwork, not a new composition. Preserve all established character identity, facial expression, pose, clothing design, proportions, camera angle, framing, positions, setting, title placement, color family, and narrative action. Keep the exact title "DEFY THE HEAVENS" with the same beautiful gold serif letterforms and layout; correct crisp edges and intentional metallic shading.
Main requested change: remove the characteristic noisy AI-image microtexture. The current picture has excess crawling grain, granular speckles, chaotic tiny scratch marks and falsely sharpened texture across clouds, skin, silk, rocks and water. Repaint these surfaces with controlled smooth tonal transitions, clear deliberate forms and refined painterly brushwork. Replace random speckled detail with purposeful material detail: clean facial planes, coherent hair strands, graceful silk folds, clear rock planes, organized water shapes, luminous smooth clouds. More clarity and apparent definition, not added busy microdetail. No film grain, noise overlay, grunge veil, crunchy oversharpening, halos, waxy skin, smeary blur or plastic CGI. Keep actual scene lightning and meaningful debris, but simplify nonessential floating grit and glitter.
Maintain dark painterly xianxia style, rich deep colors, exquisite controlled spiritual light, expressive readable face and hands, strong cover hierarchy, clear foreground-to-background depth. Improve separation of subject from background with subtle motivated light, keep original mood and scale. Refined polished painted cover, professional print finish. Preserve landscape aspect ratio. Render at highest practical native definition, aim for 3840x2160 landscape detail. No new text, no watermark, no border, no moon.
Specific invariants: the same adult Chinese woman in the same red-and-charcoal robes sits centered in lotus posture on the same broken circular dais in the stormy mountain lake, fists on knees, eyes gazing up with tearful determined resolve. Keep gold lightning striking around her, blue-green turbulent water, towering distant mountains and heavenly opening. Preserve her face, hair ornaments and robe silhouette. Retain tear tracks deliberately, remove random skin grime/speckles. Smooth luminous skin shading, crisp eyes and lips, refined silk folds and legible stone carving. Make water and cloud shapes cleaner without flattening the drama.
